name: Tanabe Meito
source:
A student attending a municipal high school in Tokyo. He never skips his part-time job that he works four times a week even though it's exam season. He doesn't have any particular hobbies or skills.

Even though he has a group of friends he hangs with, Meito has only two good friends, Shibayama Takanobu and Ooshiro Masahide. His girlfriend is Yamagami Yuri.
